interpretation.reproduced: Observations #1-#4 (2026-11-17, and three passes on 2026-11-20 by arena-23d7ed19, arena-82d39deb and arena-c2123b9c) agreed 5/5 on the observed redirect targets. Observation #5 (2026-11-20, session b0920c92) diverged: four of the five submitted short links ended on the Amazon home page and only B0f3GKalj still resolved to a product listing. The earlier agreement therefore does not guarantee those short links resolve to those products at any given time.
interpretation.what_reproduction_does_not_prove: Every final URL ever observed carries lv=shuf (shuffle) and plpRedirect=mhFallback (listing-page fallback) - a fallback route, not a canonical resolution of the submitted token, which is why the intended_* fields stay blank. Observation #5 adds a second reason: the short links did not all resolve to product pages on the most recent pass, hours after a pass in which they all did. Nothing here says the short links are invalid - FLG-003 remains open and unresolved.
interpretation.operational_consequence: The reader-facing links on this site are NOT the submitted short links. They are built from the observed ASINs as direct https://www.amazon.com/dp/<ASIN> URLs. All five were re-opened directly on 2026-11-20 as a control (S31) and every one still served the product page and breadcrumb recorded in data/products.json. So the published links are unaffected by the short-link behaviour; what needs the owner's attention is confirming the intended destination for each product (Q-02) and the one-link Associates test (FLG-002).

probe4_note: Fourth independent observation (session arena-c2123b9c, 2026-11-20), via live HTTP resolution through the fetch_page reader, same method as observations #2 and #3. All five mappings reproduced 5/5 again. Per-row 'session'/'date'/'observation' fields mark which observation produced the row (rows without them are observation #3 by arena-82d39deb). Channel IDs varied (704/704/704/500/500) and two rows carried th=1 - recorded verbatim. Every row still carries lv=shuf and plpRedirect=mhFallback, so FLG-009's fallback-route reading stands. New per-listing observations: the Emeril <title> still says 'Six Cooking Accessories' (FLG-010 on a third capture); the Chefman 8 Qt <title> still shows the 450F Hi-Fry wording against captured 200-400F copy (FLG-005); the ThermoMaven <title> wording rotated again (consistent with FLG-014). probe5_note: Fifth live pass (session b0920c92, 2026-11-20), after arena-c2123b9c's observation #4 had reproduced 5/5 product targets the same day. On this pass four of the five submitted short links ended on the Amazon home page; only B0f3GKalj still resolved to B0DZFD6R9Z. Two of the four re-fetched individually: identical. The direct /dp/ listings were re-opened as a control (S31) and all five still served the recorded products, so the published reader links are unaffected. Recorded as FLG-026; the short links' compliance status stays unresolved (FLG-003). The two passes together show the short-link behaviour is not stable over hours, which is itself a reason to treat them as unverified provenance rather than routing infrastructure.
